name: comp-289
title: Warning Notification Card
blurb: Warning card with title, description, action button, and dismiss.
description: Static warning notification card with amber alert icon, bold title, descriptive text, action button, and dismissible close. Larger vertical card layout.
use_when: You need to display a warning that requires attention with explanatory text and a clear action path.
avoid_when: For quick, dismissible alerts or error states; use smaller banner alerts instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
